profile: This is your Official ID. Update your details once. Use it everywhere automatically.
buyFromSK: Need to order for your shop? Browse items, check prices, and place your orders with StoreKing.
buyFromSeller: Need to order for your shop? Browse items, check prices, and place your orders with your SK Seller.
pos: Your smart cash counter. Quickly scan, bill walk-in customers, and accept all payment types instantly.
assistedOrder: Place orders on behalf of your customers. Browse items, build their cart, and checkout with full assistance.
createCatalog: Build your online store in minutes. Search 50,000+ items from StoreKing and add them with one click subscribe.
manageInventory: See all your stock in one place. Get alerts when low/near-expiry items and manage your entire stock easily.
manageExpense: Track every business expense in one place. Add expense records, filter by category, and manage your expense categories.
manageLocation: Organize your store layout. Map items to specific racks, ensuring your staff picks & packs every order faster!
managePrice: Control your profit. Easily set selling price for B2C and B2B customers and see your margin on every sale.
priceSlab: When someone buys more items, give them a lower price. Set different price levels for all items, menus, categories, brands, or single items.
purchaseOrder: Track everything you buy from your suppliers. Create orders, manage status, and record all incoming stock.
manageVendor: Your Supplier Master. Save vendor details, manage credit, and see your full purchase history with them.
manageNetwork: Know your customer. See all B2C/B2B history, loyalty points, and every order they've placed in one list.
manageOrder: Your dashboard to understand all customer orders from start to finish. Track every customer order status.
unconfirmedOrders: Orders that were unconfirmed due to low stock availability.
manageFulfillment: Get your orders ready for customers. Monitor every status change instantly, from New to Delivered.
lastMileDelivery: Manage your delivery staff. Assign orders, track status progress and ensure COD money is collected securely.
accountSummary: Your daily money statement. See total sales, profit, expenses, and track pending payments in one place.
kingCoins: Your customer rewards hub. Track loyalty coins (earn and spend), and manage customer redemption.
coinStore: Redeem exclusive items using KingCoins at StoreKing Coin Store.
settings: Customize your store. Easily update delivery options, adjust payment configurations, and manage your store.
settings.others: Configure other advanced settings and preferences for your store.
manageUser: Give your staff access safely. Create logins and control what they can see and do in the app.
reports: Data for better decisions. See sales, profit, GST reports (GSTR-1 and GSTR-3), and top items to help you grow your business faster.
recordPayment: Record and manage your payments. Track incoming and outgoing transactions in one place.
buyFromOtherRetailer: Buy from other retailers. Browse items, check prices, and place your orders with other retailers.
stockMaster: Item stock ledger — view item stock movements and balances.
approvalHistory: Review and manage subscription approval requests for items and uploads.
purchaseOrder.yetToReceive: Track everything you buy from your suppliers. Create orders, manage status, and record all incoming stock.
paylaterManagement: Manage credit limits, KYC, and payments for B2C & B2B users.
ordersDashboard: Overview of orders: view key metrics and track pending, processing, and completed orders.
b2bSchemes: Manage your B2B schemes. Create, edit, and delete schemes to offer different pricing to your B2B customers.
cases: A Case is a large bulk package of items, and an Inner Case is a smaller bundle within it. Manage Case/Inner Case packaging for better inventory control.
missingConfigProducts: Items listed here have configurations missing. Select items & add to cart to update their packaging, margins, or stock details in bulk.
pendingSettlement: Orders with refunds pending to be settled back to the customers.
barcodeScan: Search by name, model or barcode to add products — no match? StoreKing AI can help.
barcodeScanHistory: Products found by StoreKing AI from your barcode scans. Check status, subscribe SK suggestions, or add new products.
catalogCart: Review your selected items and configure their quantity, unit type, price, and barcode. Once done, save them to add them to your inventory.
catalogCartPending: Products StoreKing AI found while scanning that aren't in the SK catalog yet. Create new ones or link similar items to add them to your store.
